data.name: Name
data.price_extra: Grid tariff and fees per kWh

data_description.price_source: Spot prices decide when it pays to heat. Nord Pool is free and needs no account; Tibber customers can use Tibber.
data_description.presence_entities: When none of them are home, the heat is lowered until the afternoon. Needs the Home Assistant app on each phone.
data_description.weather_entity: The outdoor temperature makes the expected room temperature more accurate.
data_description.price_extra: Only used to estimate cost. Around 0.45 kr in Norway (grid energy charge + electricity tax incl. VAT). Use 0 with Tibber if it already includes this.

price_sensor.title: Price sensor

data_description.price_sensor: A sensor with hourly/15-min prices in its attributes (Nordpool HACS, Tibber, ENTSO-e, Energi Data Service…).

price_sensor.description: Choose a sensor that has today's prices in its attributes, e.g. from Nordpool (HACS), ENTSO-e or Energi Data Service.

house.title: About your home
house.description: Rough answers are fine – the defaults work for most homes. This gives each room a starting model for how fast it heats and cools; history makes it precise later.

data_description.insulation: Old: before ~1980 and not upgraded. Good: newer than ~2010 or upgraded.

zones.title: Found in your home
zones.description:
{found}

Choose which thermostats Heat Planner should control. Thermostats without a sensor are controlled in percent. You can change everything later.

history.title: Learn from history
history.description: Heat Planner can read the last 30 days from Home Assistant's own history to learn how fast each room heats up and cools down, and how much power each heater uses. This makes the expected temperature and the cost estimates much more accurate. The data never leaves your Home Assistant.

setup_method.title: How do you want to set up the rooms?
setup_method.description: An AI assistant can turn a short description of your everyday life into day curves and settings for every room. You review the result before anything is used.

menu_options.ai_auto: Let AI set it up (uses the AI already in Home Assistant)
menu_options.ai_copy: Use Claude or ChatGPT myself (copy and paste)
menu_options.zones: Pick rooms myself with sensible defaults

ai_auto.title: Tell us about your everyday life
ai_auto.description: Heat Planner sends this, your home description and the list of thermostats (no history, no names of people) to the AI you choose.

data_description.routine: Describe your everyday life in your own words – when you get up, leave, come home and go to bed, weekdays and weekends, who sleeps where, rooms you want extra warm or cool.

ai_copy.title: Tell us about your everyday life
ai_copy.description: Next you get a ready-made text to paste into Claude (claude.ai) or ChatGPT.

data_description.routine: Describe your everyday life in your own words – when you get up, leave, come home and go to bed, weekdays and weekends, who sleeps where, rooms you want extra warm or cool.

ai_paste.title: Copy, paste, paste back
ai_paste.description:
1. Copy all the text in the first box.
2. Paste it into a new chat in Claude or ChatGPT.
3. Paste the whole answer into the second box and press Submit.

energy.title: Electricity contract and capacity tariff
energy.description: What you actually pay per kWh decides what is worth doing. With a fixed price (e.g. Norgespris) moving heat between hours saves almost nothing – then the grid tariff and keeping the monthly peak low matter most.

data.peak_limit: Keep the monthly peak low (capacity tariff)

data_description.contract: Spot with support: the state pays 90 % above 77 øre/kWh (Norway).
data_description.grid: Elvia 2026: 36.40 øre day, 26.40 øre night/weekend. Choose custom to enter your own.
data_description.extra: Supplier mark-up or anything else per kWh.
data_description.peak_limit: Spreads heating between rooms so the average of the month's three highest hours stays in the current capacity step.
data_description.house_power_sensor: E.g. a Tibber Pulse or HAN reader. Without one, only the heaters' own load is counted.

error.nordpool_failed: Could not set up Nord Pool automatically. Check the internet connection, or add Nord Pool under Devices & services.

error.ai_invalid: Could not read the answer. Paste the whole answer, including the { and } characters.
error.ai_no_zones: The answer did not contain any of the thermostats found. Try again.
